_note: Build stages for the web tracker (site Stages tab). Full PASS/FIX/STOP numbers are in docs/TEST_GATES.md; keep the two in step.

stages.title: Fit coupons and templates
do: Measure the coupon holes, nut pockets and the gauge diameter
gates: M2 x 0.4 slides through a 2.2-2.4 mm hole
Rotor gauge 145.0 +/- 0.3 mm on two axes
Owned 2.0 mm screws thread an M2 x 0.4 nut

stages.title: First functional prints, real LW-PLA mass
do: Print CAM_19mm_cradle, one SP1 + SC1, WRE2 sample in the production LW-PLA profile
Weigh the E2 sample; density = mass / slicer volume
gates: LW-PLA effective density <= 0.80 g/cm3
Servo fits SP1 with full travel +/- 30 deg
Camera field of view shows the horizon

stages.title: Guarded single-motor and EDF bench
do: Motor on the real V18 G10 motor plate on a 10 x 10 rail stub, guarded stand
Run firmware/thrust_stand, ingest the log, re-run the budget
gates: Worst-motor hover fraction <= 0.50 (budget G4)
Hover endurance >= 2 min (G5)
Loaded voltage >= 3.5 V/cell at 100 %
Motor <= 70 C, ESC <= 80 C at hover throttle
Current sensor within 5 % of the watt meter

stages.title: Carbon and G10 structure, real gear, no skin
do: Cut tubes per cad/v18/carbon_cut_list.json, G10 per cad/v18/dxf and cad/interface/out/dxf
Fit crossing clamps and belly straps
gates: Each crossing and motor clamp holds 3 x bench max thrust without slip
Gear survives a 10 cm drop at planned mass

stages.title: Trays and covers with real cases
do: TRAY_A/B, H1/H2 with the real battery, FC, harness
gates: Battery pull test 3 x pack weight without movement
Covers come off without unplugging anything

stages.title: EDF dry-fit
do: EDF_saddle x2, D1, D2, SF_EDF_ear_bracket on the outriggers (EDF power disconnected)
gates: Blade tip clearance uniform to +/- 0.3 mm
Thrust path is bracket -> outrigger, not the printed saddle

stages.title: Wings, one then its mirror
do: Print and assemble one wing, gauge every well including seams, then the mirror
gates: 145 mm gauge passes all four wells
Left/right wing mass within 3 %
Flap neutral interference relieved (V18 check C3)

stages.title: Hinges, controls, all five servos
gates: Full travel + 5 deg both sides, no horn/pushrod/wire contact
Correcting directions verified

stages.title: Props-off electrical bring-up
do: docs/WIRING.md section 13 order, every rail measured
gates: No brownout with servos sweeping and motors spinning
Motor test A-D order and direction correct
Clean video

stages.title: Weigh, CG, stability, failsafes
do: Weigh the aircraft, measure the CG, enter both, re-run the budget
gates: Hover balance and static margin gates PASS on measured values (G1-G3)
Simultaneous lift + EDF current measured (G6, G7)
Failsafes configured and tested

stages.title: Flight qualification with an experienced pilot
do: Taxi, hover, wing-borne flight and transitions as separate sessions at a proper site
gates: Each session's own plan PASS
First flight line-of-sight, not immersive FPV
Decoration last, then reweigh and rebalance
